name: perturbation_v1
description: Curated 15-task set for perturbation protocol experiments. 3 easy, 7 medium, 5 hard. Selected for repo diversity, clear difficulty gradient, and meaningful agent navigation requirements.

easy.rationale: Add model class to app_list context. Single-line addition to admin view. Clear requirement, minimal codebase navigation.
Fix D exponent separator replacement in FITS record parsing. Well-scoped string operation bug with existing test coverage hints.
Assertion rewrite fails when first expression in file is a number mistaken as docstring. Single-line guard fix.

medium.rationale: FileBasedCache has_key is susceptible to TOCTOU race condition. Requires understanding cache backend internals and exception handling patterns.
ModelChoiceIteratorValue is not hashable after 3.0->3.1 migration. Requires understanding Django forms and widget option rendering.
str() on pytest.raises context variable behaves differently from normal exception catch. Requires understanding pytest exception handling internals.
Allow lists in the dict values of the hooks argument. Requires understanding the hook registration mechanism in the requests library.
Text label with empty line causes TypeError in PostScript backend. Requires navigating matplotlib's backend rendering pipeline.
autodoc_type_aliases does not apply to variables and attributes. Requires understanding Sphinx's autodoc extension and type annotation processing.
Pipeline should implement __len__. Requires understanding sklearn Pipeline's indexing and iteration interface.

hard.rationale: RidgeClassifierCV's store_cv_values parameter issue. Multi-hunk fix requiring understanding of cross-validation internals and parameter propagation.
Merging 3+ media objects throws unnecessary MediaOrderConflictWarnings. Largest patch in the set. Requires understanding Django's media merging algorithm and topological sort.
nthroot_mod function misses root x=0 mod p. Requires number theory knowledge and understanding of SymPy's modular arithmetic implementation.
Unroll iterable for all/any calls to get better assertion failure reports. Requires deep understanding of pytest's assertion rewriting AST machinery.
Setting style.library['seaborn-colorblind'] causes key error on v3.6.1. Multi-hunk fix involving style registry, deprecation handling, and backwards compatibility.
